thread:
Kai: Quick follow-up from the DR postmortem 1: putting an action tracker here. react with :white_check_mark: if you accept ownership.

Marta: ack, I'll take routing policy + canary script.

Ben: ack, backups verification + restore runbook edits.

Ash: I'll do automation for the playbook tests and add alerts.

Kai: Recurring problems we saw: intermittent BGP flaps -> partial region isolation, expired/incompatible S3 lifecycle rules breaking incremental backups, and unclear restore steps for Dedicated pools.

Priya: Also saw a KMS Denied event during restore attempts; we should add a preflight KMS check.

Kai: Agreed. Action items:
1) Multi-region routing policy + failover window (owner: Marta) - target failover <45s, health-check gating. Due 2026-04-10.
2) BGP session monitoring + alert (owner: Ash) - add netdiag link + slack notify. Due 2026-03-30.
3) Nightly backup-restore smoke test (owner: Ben) - isolated VPC, cron 0 3 * * * UTC, quick smoke ~8m. Due 2026-03-28.
4) Restore runbook: quick checklist (<=10 steps) + full playbook (owner: Ben + Ash). Due 2026-04-05.
5) KMS preflight commands in runbook (owner: Priya) - add fallback contacts. Due 2026-03-25.
6) 5% canary traffic-shift script post-failover (owner: Marta) - 10m validation window. Due 2026-04-12.
7) Quarterly DR game day schedule (owner: Kai) - propose dates & invites. Due 2026-03-22.

Marta: Draft routing snippet: 
```
# prefer us-west primary, fallback eu-west
set bgp local-preference 200 for 10.0.0.0/8
route-map PREFER_US_WEST permit 10
 match ip address prefix-list US_WEST
 set local-preference 200
# health-check: /healthz -> 3 consecutive 200s required
```

Ash: lgtm. Tie gating to both proxy and control-plane; probe interval 30s. I'll add alerts and PD escalation.

Ben: Nightly job scheduled in staging tomorrow 03:00 UTC. Full run ~45m, smoke ~8m. Will post results to #incidents.

Priya: KMS snippet I suggest: `aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://test.enc --key-id alias/redwood-main` -> exit 0 means OK. I'll add contacts.

deploy-bot: New runbook created: DR/restore_quick_checklist.md by Ben at 2026-03-18T09:12:00Z

Marta: For routing changes let's allow a 2-hour canary window with auto-rollback if error-rate >1.5% or p95 latency x2.

Kai: Proposed game day dates: Apr 15 (dry) and Jul 15 (full). Cross-team required: Eng, SRE, Networks, Product. Who's in?

Marta: in.

Ben: in.

Priya: in.

Ash: in.

Kai: Any blockers to the due dates? If none, :white_check_mark: on the tracker and update the spreadsheet: https://redwood.internal/sheets/dr-playbook. We'll reconvene in one week.

Ben: need an authorized access window to run a full prod-like restore; coordinating with Security.

Priya: will add KMS fallback contact today.
